content:
The v4.13.0 release of Lean arrived a few days ago!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language. Please read the release notes for details.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.13.0.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.13.0.

  • the stable branch on each repository has been updated to use v4.13.0
  • there is a v4.13.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

I'll also announce at the same time the arrival of the release candidate v4.14.0-rc2. The master/main branches of Batteries/Aesop/Mathlib are all on this release candidate now.
